name: Shawbrook Group PLC
summary: Operating through its subsidiary, Shawbrook Bank Limited, Shawbrook Group plc is a United Kingdom-based financial institution that delivers a broad spectrum of lending and savings solutions to both private individuals and businesses. The company's offerings encompass a comprehensive range of personal and business savings accounts, alongside diverse personal loan options for needs such as weddings, home improvements, and vehicle purchases, as well as debt consolidation and point-of-sale financing. For its commercial clientele, Shawbrook provides a wide array of funding solutions, including asset, structured, leveraged, fund, platform, and revolving credit facilities, in addition to general corporate lending. Furthermore, the group is active in the property finance sector, offering buy-to-let mortgages, commercial mortgages, development finance, and bridging finance services. Incorporated in 2010 and based in Brentwood, UK, Shawbrook Group plc functions as a subsidiary of Marlin Bidco Limited.
